sentence: This project builds a mathematical understanding of network-based methods for analyzing data and checks how accurate the scientific conclusions from them are.
This project creates course modules that teach how attacks on artificial intelligence in robotic systems work and how to defend against them.
This project develops mathematical methods to study stochastic partial differential equations and how they connect to random fields and random fractals.
This project tries to find out how the human brain and body combine force, impedance and feedback control to move during physical interactions.
This project builds computational tools and a database that predict how disordered parts of proteins bind to other proteins and to nucleic acids.
This project builds a shared platform of brain activity data and processing tools so scientists can use AI to study brain function.
This project tracks how microplastic particles break down in soils and how soil microbes take up the carbon from them.
This project builds efficient and reliable control methods for nonlinear systems such as robots and aircraft in stochastic environments.
This project develops algorithms that solve linear algebra problems for nonsymmetric matrices by using polynomials to damp oscillatory behavior.
This project pulls together 35 years of research to find out how ticks, bacteria, wildlife and people interact to shape Lyme disease risk.
This project develops ways to use low-cost sensing and interpretable machine learning to find defects in metal additive manufacturing while parts are made.
This project studies how a freshwater plant changes its leaf shape and the way it takes up carbon dioxide when water levels change, by looking at its genes.
This project designs surfaces that push away liquids and still survive being folded, hammered or touched, by mixing soft and rigid materials.
This project builds theory and computational tools to predict how fast invasion fronts move and what patterns they leave behind.
This project studies how energetic particles and waves interact in plasmas when the background magnetic field is three-dimensional.
This project improves a mobile app and data tools used to record and share the timing of life-cycle events in plants and animals.
This project builds artificial intelligence tools that detect deepfakes and give clear explanations of the detection results.
This project builds a framework that uses graphics processing units to find and match subgraphs in big graphs.
This project engineers a plant that senses persistent industrial chemicals in soil and shows a visible signal that drones or satellites can detect.
